description: Fix styling in AdminPanelPage (tabs), AdminUsersTab (chips, row padding), AdminUserDetail (back button, warning items), and AdminReportDetail (back button) to match the HTML mockup. Independent of FEAT-001 in terms of files except AdminPanelPage where both touch — FEAT-001 must complete first so FEAT-002 edits the already-updated AdminPanelPage.
steps: Modify src/pages/AdminPanelPage.tsx — tab segment control: In the TABS.map() button: (a) Change className from '...py-2 text-xs font-semibold...' to '...py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold...' (applies to both active and inactive since it's a single className string shared by the button). (b) Change <span className='hidden sm:inline'> to <span className='inline'> so tab labels always show on all screen sizes. Both active and inactive tab states should get fontWeight:600 in inline style to ensure consistency.

Modify src/components/admin/AdminUsersTab.tsx — filter chips: In the filter chip button's isActive ternary: inactive branch currently has className '...text-xs font-semibold...'. Change to '...text-[12.5px] font-medium...'. Active branch currently has '...text-xs font-semibold...'. Change to '...text-[12.5px] font-semibold...' (keep semibold for active). The base className string shared by both should have the size/weight removed and placed per-branch, or update both branches.

Modify src/components/admin/AdminUsersTab.tsx — user row padding: In the user row button className, change 'p-3.5' to 'px-3.5 py-3' (reduces vertical padding from 14px to 12px, horizontal stays 14px).

Modify src/components/admin/AdminUserDetail.tsx — back button: (a) Add state: const [hoveredBack, setHoveredBack] = useState(false); near the top of the component function (after existing state). (b) Change the back button from: className='inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors' style={{ color: 'var(--adm-muted-fg)' }} to: className='inline-flex items-center gap-2 transition-colors' style={{ background:'transparent', border:'none', color: hoveredBack ? 'var(--adm-fg)' : 'var(--adm-muted-fg)', fontWeight:500, fontSize:13, padding:'6px 8px 6px 0', cursor:'pointer' }} onMouseEnter={() => setHoveredBack(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setHoveredBack(false)}. CRITICAL: Keep button text exactly as 'Back to Users' with ArrowLeft icon — the test queries getByRole('button', { name: /Back to Users/i }).

Modify src/components/admin/AdminUserDetail.tsx — warning history items: In user.warnings.map((w) => ...), find the outer div of each warning item. Current: className='flex items-start justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl p-3' style={{ background:'hsl(213 40% 20% / .45)', border:'1px solid var(--adm-border)', borderLeft:'3px solid var(--adm-warn)' }}. Change to: className='flex items-start justify-between gap-3' (remove rounded-xl and p-3) style={{ background:'hsl(213 40% 20% / .45)', border:'1px solid var(--adm-border)', borderLeft:'3px solid var(--adm-warn)', borderRadius:12, padding:'12px 14px' }}.

Modify src/components/admin/AdminReportDetail.tsx — back button: (a) Add state: const [hoveredBack, setHoveredBack] = useState(false); after existing state declarations. (b) Change back button same as AdminUserDetail step above but text stays 'Back to Reports': className='inline-flex items-center gap-2 transition-colors' style={{ background:'transparent', border:'none', color: hoveredBack ? 'var(--adm-fg)' : 'var(--adm-muted-fg)', fontWeight:500, fontSize:13, padding:'6px 8px 6px 0', cursor:'pointer' }} onMouseEnter={() => setHoveredBack(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setHoveredBack(false)}.
acceptance_criteria: Tab labels (Users, Events, Audit Log, Reports) are always visible, not hidden on small screens
Tab buttons have 10px vertical padding (py-2.5) and 14px font size (text-sm)
Inactive filter chips in AdminUsersTab use 12.5px font and medium weight
User row buttons in AdminUsersTab have 12px vertical padding (py-3) and 14px horizontal (px-3.5)
Back button in AdminUserDetail is borderless/transparent, muted color, font-weight 500, still reads 'Back to Users' for test compatibility
Back button in AdminReportDetail is borderless/transparent, muted color, font-weight 500
Warning history items have borderRadius 12 and padding 12px 14px
findings: All 6 styling steps implemented. Build succeeds (vite build ✓). TypeScript exits clean (tsc --noEmit ✓). All 10 AdminPanelPage tests pass. Full suite OOM is a pre-existing environment constraint (insufficient RAM for 32 parallel Vitest workers), not caused by these changes. Key changes: tab py-2.5/text-sm/always-visible labels; filter chips text-[12.5px] with medium/semibold split; user rows px-3.5 py-3; back buttons in UserDetail and ReportDetail are borderless with hover color transition; warning items use borderRadius:12 padding:12px 14px inline style.
